summary: Sadot Group Inc. filed an 8-K to report entering two separate Debt Settlement and Share Issuance Agreements with creditors Cedar Advance LLC and Agile Capital Funding LLC/Agile Lending LLC. Under the agreements, the Company issued 45,000 shares of common stock to each creditor in full settlement of approximately $1,876,500 and $1,482,912.50 of outstanding indebtedness, respectively, plus accrued interest and fees. No cash consideration was paid. The issuances were made without registration under the Securities Act, relying on an exemption. This is a balance-sheet restructuring, not a special situation; the company is simply converting debt to equity. No premium, price per share, or other standard deal terms are applicable.
